run: 10:30 AM ET run (Monday). Graded all of Sunday's 3 PM tickets first (the Prime-Time Unders parlay settles on MNF tonight). Today's picks focus on NBA unders only where both offenses are cold, Brandon Miller's scoring form, NBA cushions of +9.5 or more, NHL team totals, the MNF Bears team-total under, soccer double chance/unders, and opening-night college basketball favorites. Every leg starts at 12:30 PM ET or later.

singles.reason: Charlotte has scored 89, 79 and 104 in its last three games, and these teams met on 10/28 in a 97-89 game (186 total). The main total is about 213.5, and our line is still at plus money. Lesson applied: we only play NBA unders when BOTH offenses are struggling (Sunday's misses were fast West Coast games).

Oklahoma City has scored only 96 and 98 in its last two games with a short-handed rotation, and its defense is still elite. The main total is about 231.5; Cleveland's pace slows against OKC's ball pressure. Price: +106.

Brooklyn is on the second night of a back-to-back after scoring 94 and 98 in its last two, and Knicks games are averaging about 215. Five of the Knicks' last six games went under 217.5. The Nets' tired legs and the Knicks' slow half-court pace point under. Price: +106.

Miller has scored 39, 31, 19 and 24 in his last four (28.3 average), and he's the Hornets' clear top option. Lesson applied: we play props only when the line is 1.5+ below his average, and this one is 3.3 below. He scored 31 against Detroit on 10/28. Price: +132.

parlays.name: Hockey Team Totals + MNF Bears Under
parlays.reason: Three legs from our strongest angles: NHL team totals (one for, one against) and a team-total under on Monday night. Lesson applied: safe parlays stay at 2-3 legs and no NBA overs are paired with NHL overs.

legs.reason: Colorado is one of the NHL's top offenses (-240 ML) visiting rebuilding Chicago, which allows plenty of goals. They need only 3.

legs.pick: Red Wings Team Total Under 3.5 Goals
legs.market: Detroit Red Wings Alt Total Goals
legs.reason: Detroit is on the road against Florida's structured defense. Their main team total is about 2.5, so 4+ goals would be needed to lose.
Chicago's offense is on the road against Seattle's top-tier defense in a loud building. Their main team total is about 20.5, so this gives 4 extra points.

parlays.name: Big Cushion Road Dogs
parlays.reason: Three bought-up cushions of 9.5 to 17.5 points. Lesson applied: +9.5 cushions went 2-for-2 on Sunday and +7.5 missed, so every leg here is +9.5 or more, and no spread is 12+ in the favorite's direction.

legs.reason: Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards and is about a -9.5 favorite, so Milwaukee has 8 extra points of cushion. The Wolves lost at San Antonio by 10 in their last game.
Denver is only about a -4.5 favorite (-168 ML), so we're getting 7 extra points. Teams favored by under 5 rarely win by 12+.
Memphis is only about a -4.5 favorite (-178 ML), so New Orleans gets 6 extra points. Even short-handed, they have to lose by 11+ for this to miss.

lottery.name: Best Shot $500K
lottery.reason: A $5 ticket with 25 legs, one per event. Each leg is the highest-probability line we could find (no coin flips; each is about 64-95% implied). Mix: NBA unders where both offenses are struggling, big-favorite spreads, NHL favorites and puck lines, the MNF Seahawks team-total under, soccer unders and Atalanta, and high-major college home favorites. Honest note: hitting the full +9,999,900 target would have needed about 8 extra coin-flip legs, which our lessons rule out, so the ticket stops at the price shown.

legs.reason: Charlotte has scored 89, 79 and 104 in its last three games, and these teams met on 10/28 in a 97-89 game (186 total). This is 4 points above the main total.
Brooklyn is on the second night of a back-to-back after scoring 94 and 98 in its last two, and Knicks games are averaging about 215; this is 8 points of cushion above our single's line.
Oklahoma City has scored only 96 and 98 in its last two games with a short-handed rotation, and its defense is still elite. This is 5 points above the main total.
Philadelphia is a -520 home favorite, with the main spread at about -11.5. At -6.5 we stay well under our 12+ NBA spread limit.
Dallas is a -430 favorite against Sacramento's league-worst defense (Flagg has 25+ in three straight). This is a bought-down line from about -10.
Minnesota is a -450 favorite even without Edwards, and they beat the Clippers by 26 without him.
San Antonio is a -1000 home favorite over rebuilding Utah, with the main spread at about -16.5. This line gives 7 points of cushion.
Memphis is at home against a short-handed New Orleans team. -178 (64%) passes our filter.
Boston is on the second night of a back-to-back, and Houston has won big at home (beating MIL by 32 and OKC by 21). Price: -198.
Toronto at -186 (65%) against a Clippers team that has been blown out twice this week.
Florida is a home favorite at -182 (65%).
This is close to a pick'em (VGK -115) on Boston's home ice. They only have to avoid losing by 2+.
Colorado is a -240 favorite (71%) at rebuilding Chicago.

Both teams are bottom-10 defensively, and the Sharks' team total over 2.5 is -210. Price: -168. Lesson applied: we only take NHL overs in a weak-goalie/weak-defense game, and we don't pair them with NBA overs.
Seattle's main team total is about 24.5, and the Bears' defense has kept this a mid-40s total game.
This is the lowest-total match on the board (Under 3.5 is -420).
Atalanta is at home against Parma, -220 (69%), with double chance at -750. Lesson applied: we use a 90-minute ML only for a clear class gap and not in derbies.
A low-event matchup: Under 3.5 is -480, and Under 2.5 is the favorite at -162.
Newcastle at home with double chance (-300). Lesson applied: double chance, not the 90-minute ML.
The reigning national champion is at home against Miami (-220, 69%).
Gonzaga is at home against Purdue (-245, 71%) and rarely loses there.
Arizona is at home against UCLA (-200, 67%).
Saint Mary's is at home against Illinois State (-280, 74%).
Iowa State is at home against Memphis (-2100). This is a safety leg.
Tulane is at home against UT Martin (-245, 71%).

history.whyExplanation: Lost on one leg: Toronto lost 121-114 at home to Orlando. Miami and Detroit both won easily.

history.name: Unders Trio

legs.event: New Jersey Devils @ Vegas Golden Knights

history.whyExplanation: Lost two of three legs. Devils-Golden Knights went to 7 goals and Baylor-UCF finished at 50 (41-9), so a one-sided blowout still beat the under. Pistons-Nets under hit easily (204).
history.lesson: Unders in college football blowouts are risky because the favorite can score on its own. Use unders only where both offenses are weak. The NBA under based on pace and injuries was right.

history.name: 1st-Quarter Scorers
history.whyExplanation: Lost on one leg: Brunson scored only 2 first-quarter points because he was setting up teammates (two assists). Flagg had 12, Giannis 7, and Barnes and Garland 7 each.
history.lesson: Even -1200 legs miss. Five heavy favorites stacked together still lose about 1 time in 3 to 4. Use fewer legs, and avoid players whose first-quarter role is passing.

history.name: Notre Dame 1st Quarter -7.5

legs.actual: ND 7, Navy 3 after 1Q (won the quarter by 4)

history.whyExplanation: Lost. Notre Dame led only 7-3 after the first quarter. Navy kicked a field goal on its opening drive, and the Irish didn't take over until the second half (35-13 final, so the full-game read was right).
history.lesson: First-quarter spreads of 7 or more need a fast-starting offense AND an opponent that can't move the ball early. Service academies' ball-control offenses shorten the first quarter, so take the full game or 1H instead of a 1Q line against option teams.

history.lesson: Avoid 90-minute soccer moneylines in derbies and top-of-table matches (Der Klassiker): the draw is ~25% even for a big favorite. Use 'Double Chance' or draw-no-bet style markets, or leave them out.

history.name: NHL Shooters Ladder

legs.event: St. Louis Blues @ Detroit Red Wings

history.whyExplanation: Lost. MacKinnon (5), Pastrnak (4), Thompson (8) and DeBrincat (3) hit, but Matthews, Celebrini and Caufield had 2 shots each and Robertson had 1.
history.lesson: 3+ shots on goal is closer to 55-65% for most stars, not 75%; eight of them stacked is a long shot. Use 2+ SOG for ladders, or only 3+ for players averaging 4+ shots.

history.name: Rangers Team Total Over 3.5 Goals
history.whyExplanation: LOST. The Rangers scored only once against Edmonton's backup goalie. Edmonton controlled play, and the backup goalie angle didn't matter because the Rangers' offense never generated enough chances.
history.lesson: A backup goalie alone doesn't make a team-total over. The shooting team also needs a strong recent offense. Check the scoring team's own goals per game first.

history.name: Ducks Team Total Over 3.5 Goals
history.whyExplanation: WON at +114. Anaheim scored 6 against Ottawa's tired back-to-back team and its .859 goalie. This was exactly the setup we expected.
history.lesson: Back-to-back plus a weak goalie plus a home team with a decent offense is the best NHL team-total spot. Keep using it.

legs.event: Los Angeles Clippers @ Golden State Warriors

history.whyExplanation: LOST by 16.5 points. Even with injuries, the remaining Warriors shot well and the pace stayed high. Injured stars didn't slow this game down.
history.lesson: NBA injury unders went 1-for-4 Sunday, and every miss was a fast-paced or West Coast game. Only play NBA unders when BOTH offenses are struggling (low recent scoring), not just because players are out.

history.name: Backup Goalie Team Totals
history.whyExplanation: LOST. The Ducks leg hit (6 goals), but the Rangers managed only one goal against Edmonton's backup, so their Over 2.5 missed.
history.lesson: Pair team-total overs only when the scoring team is in good form. We hadn't checked the Rangers' own recent scoring.

history.lesson: Cushions of +9.5 or more went 2-for-2 and +7.5 missed. Set the minimum NBA cushion at +9.5, and don't back a road dog in a high-pace game.

topLessons: NBA unders only when BOTH offenses are struggling; injury unders in fast West Coast games went 0-3 on Nov 1.
NBA cushions: +9.5 minimum (+9.5 went 2-0, +7.5 missed on Nov 1).
Soccer: use double chance, not 90-minute moneylines (LAFC -165 lost and sank the Monday ladder, the third time this has happened).
NHL team-total overs need a weak or tired goalie AND an offense in form (Ducks 6 hit; Rangers scored only 1 against a backup).
Soccer: use Double Chance or goals markets, not 90-minute moneylines, in derbies and top matches (Bayern drew 2-2 and sank an 18-of-19 ladder).
NHL shots: 3+ SOG only for players averaging 4+ shots; use 2+ for ladders.
College alt spreads of -8.5 or more missed 4 of 7; avoid them and late-night G5 favorites.
NHL team totals and NBA injury unders went 9-1 in the Best Shot; build around them.
Buying down a pick'em favorite, or a short-handed dog at +3.5, is still a coin flip; get +5.5 or more cushion or skip.
Road conference favorites at coin-flip prices (Ohio State at USC, SMU at Syracuse) keep losing; use home favorites or cushion.
The 64%+ favorite filter is 9-for-9 in UFC; keep it for fight and tennis ladders.
Keep NBA overs apart from NHL overs in parlays; a blowout kills the NBA over.
Coin-flip moneylines (-110 to -150) killed the long tickets: 0-4 in the morning Best Shot. Lottery legs need ~75%+ true probability.
Big NBA spreads (-12 or more) are fragile in garbage time: Celtics -15.5 won by 14 and missed twice.
